svg.title: Darkroom — electronics view
svg.desc: Illustrative spacing of the parts the sled carries; every offset is a translation that collapses to the CAD position. Drawn from cad/darkroom.scad; not to scale.

g.text: Illustrative spacing of the parts the sled carries; every offset is a translation that collapses to the CAD position.

Concept geometry from cad/darkroom.scad (v0.4); not a fabrication drawing or a confirmed build. The microSD reader is a placeholder board; display and PiSugar fit,
